---
title: "Installing FreqEstimationModel"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

`FreqEstimationModel` is available from the [plasmogenepi.r-universe](https://plasmogenepi.r-universe.dev/FreqEstimationModel). The package imports `doMC`, so install it on macOS or Linux.

```{r install, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(
  "FreqEstimationModel",
  repos = c("https://plasmogenepi.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org")
)
```

Conda is another option. The package is on [Bioconda](https://anaconda.org/bioconda/r-freqestimationmodel) as `r-freqestimationmodel`:

```{bash install-conda, eval=FALSE}
conda install -c conda-forge -c bioconda r-freqestimationmodel
```

The [package repository](https://github.com/aimeertaylor/FreqEstimationModel) also documents installation from GitHub, including the vignettes:

```{r install-github, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github(
  "aimeertaylor/FreqEstimationModel",
  build_vignettes = TRUE,
  dependencies = TRUE
)
```
